# Records reference

Record layout version 1.

Records are what factorymeter keeps in its store. A source adapter turns what it reads from GitHub, Linear or Jira into these records and nothing else, and every metric is computed from them. So a new source needs no change to a metric.

Every time is UTC. A time that has not happened is null, never a zero date. A record id is stable: syncing the same thing twice replaces the record.

| Record | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`ticket`](#ticket) | An issue on GitHub, Linear or Jira. Tickets feed the spec station. |
| [`change`](#change) | A pull request. Changes feed the code, review and merge stations, and tie CI runs and deploys to the line. |
| [`ci_run`](#ci_run) | One attempt of one CI workflow on one commit. Runs on a commit of a change feed the ci station. |
| [`deploy`](#deploy) | One deployment to an environment, or one published release. Deploys feed the verify and release stations. |
| [`link`](#link) | A tie between two records: a change that closes a ticket, or a change that reverts another. |

## Ticket

<a id="ticket"></a>An issue on GitHub, Linear or Jira. Tickets feed the spec station.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | Where the record came from. One of `github`, `linear`, `jira`. |
| `id` | string | Stable id, unique among tickets: the source, a colon, and the name the source never changes. That is the key on GitHub and the issue id on Linear, where a key changes when a ticket moves to another team. On Jira it is the host of the site, a slash and the issue id, such as jira:acme.atlassian.net/10009. |
| `key` | string | The name people use for the ticket: owner/repo#12 on GitHub, ENG-123 on Linear or Jira. |
| `aliases` | list of string | Keys the ticket had before, such as its key in the team or project it was moved out of. A change that names one is still linked to the ticket. Empty on GitHub. |
| `project` | string | The repository, team or project the ticket belongs to. |
| `url` | string | Link to the ticket on the source. |
| `title` | string | The title. |
| `type` | string | The kind of ticket in the source's words, such as bug or feature. Empty when the source has none. |
| `labels` | list of string | The labels on the ticket. |
| `author` | Actor | The account that created the ticket. |
| `state` | string | Where the ticket stands now, mapped onto five states. One of `backlog`, `unstarted`, `started`, `done`, `cancelled`. |
| `raw_state` | string | The state in the source's own words. |
| `created_at` | time | When the ticket was created. |
| `updated_at` | time | When the source last saw the ticket move. The sync resumes from here. |
| `started_at` | time or null | When the ticket first moved to a started state. Null when it never did, or when the source keeps no history. |
| `done_at` | time or null | When the ticket was last finished. Null when it is not done. |
| `closed_at` | time or null | When the ticket closed, done or cancelled. Null while it is open. |
| `reopened` | integer | How many times the ticket went from done back to an open state. |

### Actor

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `login` | string | The account name on the source. A GitHub bot keeps its [bot] suffix. |
| `kind` | string | What the source says the account is. One of `user`, `bot`. |

## Change

<a id="change"></a>A pull request. Changes feed the code, review and merge stations, and tie CI runs and deploys to the line.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | Where the record came from. One of `github`. |
| `id` | string | Stable id, unique among changes: source:owner/repo#number. |
| `repo` | string | The repository, as owner/name. |
| `number` | integer | The number of the change in its repository. |
| `url` | string | Link to the change on the source. |
| `title` | string | The title. |
| `body` | string | The description. It is read for agent signatures and for ticket keys. |
| `author` | Actor | The account that opened the change. |
| `head_ref` | string | The branch the change comes from. |
| `base_ref` | string | The branch the change goes to. |
| `state` | string | Where the change stands now. One of `open`, `closed`, `merged`. |
| `draft` | boolean | True while the change is a draft. |
| `created_at` | time | When the change was opened. |
| `updated_at` | time | When the source last saw the change move. The sync resumes from here. |
| `ready_at` | time or null | When the change first asked for review. Null while it has only ever been a draft. |
| `merged_at` | time or null | When the change merged. Null when it has not. |
| `merge_sha` | string | The commit the merge left on the base branch. A deploy of that commit holds the change. Empty when the change has not merged or the source does not say. |
| `closed_at` | time or null | When the change closed, merged or not. Null while it is open. |
| `additions` | integer | Lines added. |
| `deletions` | integer | Lines deleted. |
| `changed_files` | integer | Files touched. |
| `commit_count` | integer | Commits on the change. It can be larger than the list of commits, which holds the first 100. |
| `commits` | list of Commit | The commits of the change, oldest first. |
| `reviews` | list of Review | The submitted reviews, oldest first. |

### Commit

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `sha` | string | The commit id. |
| `authored_at` | time | When the commit was written. |
| `committed_at` | time | When the commit was last applied. A rebase moves it. |
| `parents` | integer | How many parents the commit has. Two or more make it a merge commit. |
| `authors` | list of CommitAuthor | The author and every co-author. |
| `trailers` | list of Trailer | The trailer lines of the commit message, such as Co-Authored-By. |

### CommitAuthor

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `login` | string | The account the source matched the author to. Empty when it matched none. |
| `email` | string | The email on the commit. |
| `name` | string | The name on the commit. |

### Trailer

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | The trailer name, as written. |
| `value` | string | The trailer value. |

### Review

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `author` | Actor | The account that wrote the review. |
| `state` | string | What the review said. One of `approved`, `changes_requested`, `commented`, `dismissed`. |
| `submitted_at` | time | When the review was submitted. |

## CIRun

<a id="ci_run"></a>One attempt of one CI workflow on one commit. Runs on a commit of a change feed the ci station.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | Where the record came from. One of `github`. |
| `id` | string | Stable id, unique among CI runs: source:owner/repo/run/attempt. |
| `repo` | string | The repository, as owner/name. |
| `workflow` | string | The name of the workflow. |
| `event` | string | What started the run, in the source's words, such as pull_request or push. |
| `sha` | string | The commit the run ran on. It ties the run to a change. |
| `branch` | string | The branch the run ran on. A run of a merge queue is on a branch the queue made, and that name ties it to its change. |
| `attempt` | integer | 1 for the first run, more for a run that was started again. |
| `status` | string | Whether the run has finished, in the source's words. |
| `conclusion` | string | How the run ended, in the source's words, such as success or failure. Empty while it runs. |
| `created_at` | time | When the run was created. |
| `started_at` | time | When this attempt started. |
| `updated_at` | time | When the run last changed. For a finished run this is when it finished. |

## Deploy

<a id="deploy"></a>One deployment to an environment, or one published release. Deploys feed the verify and release stations.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | Where the record came from. One of `github`. |
| `id` | string | Stable id, unique among deploys: source:owner/repo/deployment/number or source:owner/repo/release/tag. |
| `repo` | string | The repository, as owner/name. |
| `via` | string | What kind of event this is on the source. One of `deployment`, `release`. |
| `environment` | string | The environment name. Empty for a release. |
| `production` | boolean | True when the environment is production. A release always is. |
| `ref` | string | The branch or tag that was deployed. |
| `sha` | string | The commit that was deployed, when the source gives it. |
| `created_at` | time | When the deploy started. |
| `finished_at` | time or null | When the deploy reported its outcome. Null when the source gives no status. |
| `outcome` | string | How the deploy ended. One of `success`, `failure`, `running`, `unknown`. |

## Link

<a id="link"></a>A tie between two records: a change that closes a ticket, or a change that reverts another.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | What the link means. One of `closes`, `mentions`, `reverts`. |
| `from` | string | The id of the change the link starts at. |
| `from_kind` | string | The kind of the record the link starts at. One of `change`. |
| `to` | string | The id of the record the link points at. |
| `to_kind` | string | The kind of the record the link points at. One of `ticket`, `change`. |
| `found` | string | Where the link was read. One of `source`, `body`, `title`, `branch`. |
